name: Shoto lightsaber
description: Shoto lightsabers, also known as lightdaggers, were scaled down lightsabers whose blades were considerably shorter than the normal. They were used by shorter combatants like Yoda, Yaddle, or Even Piell, whose stature made it impractical to wield a full-sized lightsaber, and also as off-hand weapons for duelists who employed twin-bladed techniques as part of Jar'Kai, like Ahsoka Tano, the Tenth Brother, The Stranger, and Cal Kestis.

data.name: Shoto lightsaber
data.size: Blade and hilt are shorter than a standard lightsaber
